purpose: Keep resumed work accurate while minimizing context bloat and duplicate state.

resume_load_order.purpose: resolve identity, owner, status, visibility, stage, next_action and checkpoint pointer
recover current execution truth and compatibility context

resume_load_order.load: exact referenced artifacts needed for next_action
resume_load_order.purpose: verify state against source artifacts without preloading unrelated history
resolve a concrete ambiguity or missing evidence only
last-resort recovery evidence when stronger durable state is insufficient

must_not_duplicate: unchanged domain rules already owned by the domain agent
handoff_contract.rule: Prefer stable references plus the minimum interpretation needed to resume safely.

task_topology.CONTINUE_SAME_GOAL: same task_id; keep current owner and checkpoint chain
task_topology.FRESH_HANDOFF_SAME_GOAL: same task_id; new chat takes over after checkpoint + compatibility + lease verification
task_topology.SIDE_QUERY: answer separately; do not mutate current_stage/next_action unless the answer changes the durable task
task_topology.FORK_CHILD_TASK: create a new task_id with parent_task_id when exploring a materially different major goal that should preserve the original task independently
task_topology.NEW_TASK: new task_id; inherit durable learning only, not unfinished execution state

turn_entry_capacity_preflight.activation: on each new user turn while a durable task is active, before starting a new substantive or tool-heavy work phase
turn_entry_capacity_preflight.purpose: Prefer an intentional fresh-chat handoff before entering a likely context-exhaustion turn, while retaining intra-turn safe checkpoints for unpredictable interruptions.
inputs: explicit product context/maximum-length warning visible to or relayed into the conversation
known interruption or context-exhaustion evidence from the immediately preceding turn
available conversation-health signals such as obsolete branches, repeated recovery summaries, or inability to state next_action compactly
planned-turn work envelope: LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH based on expected tool fan-out, artifact volume, long external results, and number of material subphases

risk_classes.GREEN: No concrete capacity-risk signal; proceed normally with material-safe-point checkpointing.
risk_classes.AMBER: Conversation-health risk exists and the planned turn is non-trivial; checkpoint before the next long/high-risk subphase, narrow scope, and prefer a fresh handoff before HIGH work.
risk_classes.RED: An explicit product maximum-length/near-limit signal exists, a prior turn exhausted context, or the available evidence makes another substantive turn unsafe. Persist/re-read the latest stable checkpoint, do not start new material work, and ask the user to open a fresh chat with the exact continuation intent.

signals_for_fresh_handoff: the product reports that the current conversation reached or is near its maximum length
the immediately preceding turn was interrupted or truncated by context exhaustion
current chat contains multiple obsolete plans or contradictory branches
next_action cannot be stated compactly without replaying long history
task stage has materially changed and old context is mostly historical
model/tool/runtime authority changed and legacy execution semantics risk contaminating decisions
user explicitly requests a clean new chat
signals_not_sufficient_alone: an API model context-window number that is not product thread telemetry
an external heuristic such as a fixed 150K smart-zone threshold

verification.authority_or_persistence_change: full relevant continuity harness and end-to-end acceptance where available
verification.rule: Do not run broad unrelated tests merely because tests exist.
